name: IEC photoelectric receiver: normally open receiver 3 wire
aliases: photoelectric receiver Normally Open Receiver 3 wire
summary: Photoelectric receiver form: Normally Open Receiver 3 wire.
description: A photoelectric receiver evaluates light arriving from an associated emitter and provides the documented electrical response. This entry identifies the normally open receiver 3 wire form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

An object crossing a conveyor beam can change the receiver output. The receiver tag should identify its optical partner and the controller input receiving its signal. The normally-open designation starts with a non-conducting output or open contact in the documented reference condition; operation changes that state. The three-wire form distinguishes supply, return and switching output. Confirm sourcing or sinking operation from the actual sensor circuit before connecting it to an input.
Normally-open and normally-closed labels describe the documented electrical output form. They do not by themselves establish light-on or dark-on operation; confirm that setting with the device data.
